name: NS Group, Inc.
summary: NS Group, Inc. provides rent guarantee services in Japan. The company offers rent guarantee and collection agency services. The company offers collection agency services to collect rent and other payments on behalf of real estate companies and property lessors. It also provides screening services. The company was formerly known as BCJ-54 Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NS Group, Inc. in October 2023. NS Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Osaka, Japan.
